title: Sound of the Sky OVA
synopsis: According to the official website, two extra episodes will be included in the Blu-ray and DVD volumes 4 and 7 of "Sora no Woto". The volumes 4 and 7 will be released on June 23rd (episode 7.5) and September 22nd (episode 13), respectively.

episodes.title: The Sound that Fills the Air - The City of Dawn
episodes.synopsis: The jig is up - Kanata saw Rio coming out of the distillery, and now she won't rest until she knows what's going on! Filicia proposes a little game, and if Kanata wins, they'll tell her everything. But of course, Filicia still has an ace up her sleeve...

episodes.title: First Battle - A Chair Story
episodes.synopsis: Given a letter sent to Rio from the Emperor, Kanata searches the city and ponders a question asked by Mishio of what her dreams of the future are.
